recognize_zh: 未染色的鐮刀化試驗濕片中，許多紅血球變成新月形、鐮刀狀或多角冬青葉狀，與未變形的圓形紅血球混在一起，代表檢體含 HbS。
features: Unstained bright-field wet preparation of red cells
Many red cells deformed into crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes
Admixed round biconcave red cells that remain unsickled
Variation in red cell size with some small cells
No nucleated cells or stained detail available for assessment
describe_en: Unstained wet-mount sickling test preparation shows a mixture of round red cells and numerous red cells that have deformed into crescent, sickle and holly-leaf shapes under reduced oxygen conditions. The positive result indicates the presence of hemoglobin S but does not quantify it. Hemoglobin electrophoresis or HPLC is required to distinguish sickle cell trait from sickle cell disease; in this patient, the HbS fraction of 26.3% supports sickle cell trait with coexisting alpha thalassemia.

ddx.vs: The sickling test is positive in both; HbSS and HbS/beta0-thalassemia lack HbA on HPLC, whereas trait has HbA exceeding HbS.
Echinocytes are round with regular short projections, not elongated crescent or holly-leaf forms.
Elliptocytes are smooth oval to rod shapes seen on stained smears without the pointed ends and angular holly-leaf outlines of sickled cells.
